requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that composite_credibility_score is computed deterministically for a given fixed PI input dataset.
The system must validate via unit tests that each input attribute (prior_trials_count, publications_count, fda_approval_count) contributes to the composite score according to defined weighting logic.
The system must verify that zero-value inputs (e.g., no prior trials) produce a valid composite score without runtime errors.
The system must validate that missing investigator_name results in a null or default PI credibility object without breaking the pipeline.
The system must verify that inconsistent investigator naming across sources is normalized or resolved to a single PI identity in test scenarios.
The system must execute integration tests confirming that PI credibility data is included in Evaluate Care API responses for clinical trials.
The system must validate that API responses include all schema fields defined in the PI credibility contract.
The system must confirm that trials without PI data still return a valid clinical trial response without PI credibility enrichment.
The system must validate that PI credibility enrichment does not alter or corrupt existing clinical trial fields in API responses.
The system must execute tests ensuring that large input datasets (multiple trials with multiple PIs) are processed without performance degradation beyond acceptable thresholds.
The system must validate that LLM-assisted enrichment (if used) produces structured outputs conforming to the PI schema.
The system must ensure that LLM outputs with missing fields are handled gracefully and do not break downstream scoring logic.
The system must validate that LLM-generated publication counts are numeric and within reasonable bounds before scoring.
The system must ensure that LLM-derived investigator identity resolution does not merge distinct individuals incorrectly in test scenarios.
The system must validate that LLM outputs with hallucinated FDA approvals are either corrected or excluded from scoring.
The system must ensure that LLM enrichment failures fall back to baseline data without causing pipeline failure.
The system must validate that composite scores remain within a defined bounded range (e.g., 0–100) under all tested conditions.
The system must confirm via integration tests that multiple trials in a single response each receive independent PI credibility calculations.
